build_fits_dataset: build the FiTS dataset by downloading and extracting the fits_data tarball into the datapath directory
build_fits_dataset_v2: build the FiTS v2 dataset by calling build with fits_task_version set to v2
get_dpath_by_task_version: get the correct data subdirectory path for a given FiTS task version and unseen task flag
review_build_function: review the build function to understand how it handles versioned dataset downloads and cleanup
summarize_resources: summarize the RESOURCES list to see the downloadable FiTS dataset URL and SHA-256 checksum
